message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.stamin: Slow down. The cords ache. Give us a breath.
We can't hold on, not yet. Let us rest.
Spent. Stand still a moment and we will be ready.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.status.blu: It keeps what it is given, and it remembers who gave it.
Gentle with the hurt, and strangely quiet about what it was before.
It wants the hunt more than it wants you. Be useful to it.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.card.attac: It has found its hold on you.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.card.integ: It is learning where you end.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.card.coope: It moves when you move. Mostly.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.card.domin: There is very little between you now.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.s: What it may do, and what you see of it
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.f: The small things it does when you aren't looking.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.j: Its sulks and moods when you pay attention to others.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.r: The errands and wants it asks of you.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.h: The one-time lines that tell you what a new talent does.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.settings.e: The dark vignette that creeps round the screen when it speaks.
gui.jaymospowers.web_arm.subtitle: Three slots in the symbiote's arm
gui.jaymospowers.web_arm.help: Click one thing, then another, to swap them. Shift-click an arm slot to send it to your pack.
